description: Capability for the main window. Intentionally minimal: no filesystem, shell, process, or opener permissions are granted. S1-02 renders a static placeholder only. A file-open-dialog permission and the ability to spawn exactly one child process (the local analysis service) are anticipated by docs/SPRINT_1_BACKLOG.md S1-02/S1-04/T-14, but are not implemented here — add them only in the ticket that implements that behavior, scoped to that behavior alone.
